description: NYM, 2005 June regular phase: 48 of 48 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 48 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 48 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20240809213255: 48 listed, 48 matched to MLB's picks by name (7 by surname in the same round: #179 MLB "Gregory Cain" / "Greg Cain"; #209 MLB "Jonathon Niese" / "Jon Niese"; #569 MLB "Timothy Grogan" / "Tim Grogan"; #839 MLB "Gregory Gonzalez" / "Greg Gonzalez"; #929 MLB "Matthew Anderson" / "Matt Anderson"; #1227 MLB "Nicholas Carr" / "Nick Carr"; #1372 MLB "Peter Tountas" / "Pete Tountas")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
